name: Alberite de San Juan (Spain)
description: Red field with a large white Maltese cross reaching the edges, charged at the centre with a yellow arched gateway with a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Alberite de San Juan; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
